==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Managed to get a whopping 516 GPM against PE, during the first week of LPL 2014 Spring Split, the highest number in a LoL competitive tournament.
* Used to be made fun of due to playing on one of the weakest Chinese server, then he switched to the Ionia server and reached Challenger shortly after.
* His ID in Chinese server refers to Touhou character [https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Kogasa_Tatara Kogasa Tatara].
